scope: 25 accepted Lane C positions 033-058; entries and lineage untouched

decisions.finding: The Platform Record explicitly defines 無相 as being apart from marks while amid marks, and the T48 commentary separately equates it with the great precept. The entry omits both definitions, substitutes the inference that a later triad question asks which line 'carries life and death,' and duplicates that inference.

The retained texts explicitly contrast 活語/死語 and explain 不乾 as a live saying because it can 回互 without touching the taboo. The entry converts this into generalized 'responsive freedom' and 'death opening into life.' B25's headword is spoken in the visitor-author dialogue, while the two parallel Dahui passages are not adequately identified as generic compiler/commentator acts.

The literal tracking idiom is attested, but 'derivative pursuit of verbal traces' and 'missing what stands underfoot' are interpretive synthesis rather than translated case statements. C078's headword-bearing verse/comment is left with a generic compiler attribution despite exact authorship requiring resolution.

The target identifies the four recluses, but 'withdrawal, height, and the four appearing as one' collapses distinct verse and answer images into inferred meaning. The entry must identify what each retained master actually says and translate the relevant line; its explanation currently duplicates the synthesis.

The witnesses support a named 'withered-tree Chan/teaching' and explicit criticism, but 'still, lifeless quietism' imports the guide's meditation/quietism framing as the lexical definition. The two J26 occurrences remain assigned to an unnamed compiler rather than their exact narrator or quoted speaker.

The phrase can be a request for, report of, or pointing to the late teacher's final saying; it is not necessarily a deathbed line, and 'its force comes from named transmission at the edge of death' is unsupported rhetoric. J33/T51 headword turns are left as compiler acts instead of exact questioner/narrator/quoted-speaker roles.

The impossible net-blowing image is supported, but the added specialization 'obtaining life-and-death understanding by collecting or inflating words' must be tied to explicit retained wording rather than asserted as the compound's meaning. L153's actor remains a generic compiler.

The allusion to Bian He's repeated jade presentations is valid, but 'a measure of presenting what is precious despite repeated rejection' is an interpretation of the verses. All three occurrences are attributed only to unnamed compilers although the headwords occur in authored verse/commentary contexts requiring exact author binding.

The formula and sauce-jar exchange are attested, but 'test unselective seeing' asserts purpose and psychology not stated in the turn. Two occurrences are left as compiler speech despite the full cases distinguishing raised quotation, question, and response.

The literal counter-formula and its listed streets/thorns/blades/fire are available directly in the cases. The entry instead infers 'sending activity' and 'settling in cold stillness,' then duplicates that reading; the two quoted/compiled witnesses also need exact speaker roles.

The sources explicitly discuss a southern sudden/northern gradual label and deny that the Dharma itself has sudden/gradual division. 'Two geographic essences' is imported abstraction, and all three headword instances are generically marked compiler rather than bound to the quoted statement's speaker/narrator.

The phrase belongs to Huineng's quoted self-nature declaration, but later records quoting or questioning that line do not make Huineng the exact utterer of every headword-bearing current turn. The entry conflates historical quoted author with exact utterer and adds the unquoted purpose 'against claims that mind moves.'

The cases condemn 斷滅空, but the entry imports a three-part doctrinal menu—causation, moral difference, responsive functioning—without translating which source states which contrast. All occurrences are left as unnamed compiler speech, obscuring authored exposition and quotation.

The equation is attested in quoted argument, but calling it a 'dangerous slogan' and saying masters attack vanished restraint/consequences is editorial unless anchored to exact surrounding lines. Two parallel witnesses are left as unnamed compilers, and the Huanglong record must distinguish Huanglong's own turn from material he raises.

The Platform Record line says Dharma has no sudden/gradual division while people's delusion/awakening has slowness/swiftness. The target's bare 'seeing may be slow or swift' loses that explicit contrast, and three occurrences conflate Huineng as quoted origin with exact current utterer.

The retained taxonomy can be translated directly, but the target adopts generalized 'cultivation' framing and the explanation adds the unsupported test of whether an ordering substitutes for 'personally arriving.' T48's exact author/narrator is unresolved as a generic compiler.

The term is a question-category label, normally supplied by an editor/narrator rather than spoken by the interview questioner. The entry says the questioner displays an 'attained formulation' for a teacher to 'overturn,' which adds attainment and purpose not inherent in the label; all three exact roles remain generic compiler.

The cases support the emphatic image of being clean/bare, but 'shed every attachment until nothing can be grasped' imports an interior spiritual process and the ritual contrast is unneeded. Two headword turns are left as generic compiler acts rather than exact verse/narrative roles.

The three barriers are explicitly enumerable and should be quoted/translated, but the current prose only paraphrases them and duplicates the paraphrase. One occurrence is a contents heading and the other two are generic compilers; those are bibliographic labels, not evidence of three independent utterers.

The literal action and Yangqi warning are attested, but 'a boast of uncompromising Chan speech' is interpretive characterization. The C077 and X78 occurrences are left as unnamed compiler speech although their full cases contain raised lines/verses requiring exact speaker or author binding.

The compound is a title/label for a raised case, but 'thunderous presentation precipitates a recorded breakthrough' narrates causation and significance beyond the headword. All three witnesses are labeled unnamed compilers without resolving who names/raises the case and who is the subject of the awakening narrative.

The retained verses pair beans bursting in cold ashes with other impossible images, but 'sudden living response where only spent coldness seemed to remain' is an imposed reading. Two occurrences remain generic compiler acts instead of exact verse-author/commentator roles.

The formula can be rendered literally from the exposition/instruction, but 'without establishing a mind-object' is interpretive philosophical prose not stated by the compound. Two occurrences in the same T48 work are both called unnamed compiler despite distinct quoted contexts, so independent work support is also only two works, not three.

The full dialogue clearly assigns 無空可落 to Nanyang Huizhong in reply to the monk, so exact utterer is supportable. The entry nevertheless adds the explanatory metaphor 'nowhere for a fall to stand' and a 'collapses into blankness' gloss rather than simply translating the monk's question and Huizhong's answer; it also duplicates that inference.

The literal impossible action is attested in several uses, but the generalized applications to 'conceptual explanation,' 'strained case handling,' and 'effort abandoned at breakthrough' are editorial categories. X66/X67 headword verses/comments are left as unnamed compiler acts rather than their named commentator/record-owner roles.
